20329.tail: Leg loops take the garter role in miniature and the sleeves add formality strapless versions skip - five pieces in white or black with the color decision changing mood, not contents.
20329.short_add: Five pieces where color changes mood not contents.

19013.tail: S and M with printed measurements - bust and waist for each size - make this the bunny listing to order by tape rather than hope, in the softer white colorway against the category default.
19013.short_add: Order by tape, not hope, in the softer shade.

21009.tail: Set packaging means the chain matches the collar, the bell matches the set, and the whole thing reads as one purchase rather than an assembly - black or pink, audible either way.
21009.short_add: One purchase reading as one design, not assembly.

21200.tail: Shape-holding ears through a full evening is the test plush headbands fail and this one passes, with the bell completing the cat read - white or black to match the collar line.
21200.short_add: Ears that hold shape past midnight, bell included.

19372.tail: Single-garment construction means the bride silhouette survives whatever the night involves - no separate pieces to find, nothing lost between rooms - and lace mesh washes gentle in a bag.
19372.short_add: Silhouette survives the night in one garment.

20005.tail: The headdress is the only costume marker and it removes in one motion, which makes this the maid set for nights that begin as costume and end as something else entirely.
20005.short_add: Costume marker removable in a single motion.

20188.tail: One piece in three shades is the entire offering, and the 85-130 lbs range covers the one-size market honestly - the backless knit costume reduced to its last decision, which is color.
20188.short_add: Everything decided except the color of three.

20343.tail: Five pieces in three colorways gives the three-point cat set more configuration than sets twice its price - the neck ring identifies, the leg rings finish, and the colorway sets the register.
20343.short_add: More configuration than sets twice the price.

20424.tail: Halterneck framing draws the shoulders into the silhouette - the cut doing what straps would interrupt - and the neck ring echoes the line in pink or black lace.
20424.short_add: The cut frames what straps would interrupt.

21041.tail: Fluff trim against punk leather, leopard print in three temperatures - and the 30-40 cm fit printed plainly, because the one size down from standard is the spec buyers miss.
21041.short_add: The smaller fit is printed, not buried.

21071.tail: Four set colorways on the reference format - collar, chain, bell, all matched - and the ring is calibrated to announce movement without clearing a room, which is the genre's whole negotiation.
21071.short_add: Bell calibrated between silent and clearing rooms.

18996.tail: The hood does the bunny work at the head while the backless cut keeps the costume honest below - a cold-night set that never asks anyone to choose between theme and temperature.
18996.short_add: Theme and temperature resolved in one hood.

20265.tail: Gray is the softest read in the school genre and the chiffon-mesh blend keeps the onesie sheer and breathing - the tie at the throat is the JK identification, arrived attached.
20265.short_add: JK identification attached at the throat, sheer throughout.

20662.tail: The combo decision is the listing's real choice - full kit or clothing only - and the stockings arriving matched is the detail that settles it for most buyers before they finish reading.
20662.short_add: Matched stockings settle the combo question early.

21012.tail: Double-layer bands flex where a single wide one would sit stiff, and the small bell is the quiet register of the format - white or black sets with the chain matched, retro styling throughout.
21012.short_add: Quiet bell, matched chain, flexible double band.

20060.tail: White is the rarer colorway for this reference and it shifts the read from uniform-adjacent to costume-forward - one color decision doing more work than most accessory additions.
20060.short_add: One color decision, entire register shift.

20067.tail: Bust and waist printed at 70-120 and 60-90 cm settle the size question at order time, and the pants format answers skirt management for nights involving cars, stairs, or sitting.
20067.short_add: Skirt management solved by the pants format.

20157.tail: Four pieces is the complete nun kit here - the high slit being the one design liberty that separates this from the straight habit, and black polyester keeping its drape hung between wears.
20157.short_add: Complete kit with one deliberate design liberty.

21199.tail: Two styles in sheer lace, black or white, at a price that makes the choice an experiment rather than a commitment - the anticipation accessory priced for exactly that.
21199.short_add: Priced as an experiment, built as a finisher.

19297.tail: The hat is structured where most costume hats flop, which is what keeps the uniform read intact by midnight - four pieces, blue chiffon, one size for 40-60 kg.
19297.short_add: The hat that keeps its shape past midnight.

19871.tail: Two-piece chiffon lives in the wash cycle rather than the costume box - launder after every wear, dry on a hanger overnight, and the set stays in rotation instead of retirement.

19907.tail: Red chiffon at Halloween against the black-everything default, with horns that hold their shape in storage and a neck ring soft enough to forget wearing - three pieces, one register.
19907.short_add: The red alternative to October's black default.

20215.tail: The double-tie inclusion lets the secretary flavor change without a second purchase, and milk silk justifies the choice over polyester versions the moment it is on - one size, 90-155 lbs.
20215.short_add: Flavor changes with the tie, not the purchase.

21093.tail: Printed measurements - 32-42 cm collar, 77 cm chain - are rare enough in this category to be the headline, and the cartoon bell is the loudest cute voice on the site in three colors.
21093.short_add: Printed numbers first, cartoon bell second, three colors.

19304.tail: Actual waterproofing separates this from costume-grade polyester - it works in water, not just near it - and the cartoon print holds its color through a season of chlorinated weekends.
19304.short_add: Works in water, not merely beside it.

20533.tail: Tube-top format suits the skirt-line preference over a legsuit - same bunny references, different silhouette below the waist - and five pieces in pink or red cover both moods.
20533.short_add: Skirt-line preference covered in both moods.

20570.tail: The chain between the cups does the styling bare leather cannot, and the wings carry the devil read without a headband to lose - one size across 40-70 kg, the widest three-point claim.
20570.short_add: Widest three-point range claim on the site.

19328.tail: Jumpsuit construction pays off at the end of the night - nothing ridden up, nothing tangled, straps held their line all evening - and the lace survives a wash bag where wovens fray.
19328.short_add: End-of-night proofing built into the jumpsuit.

19382.tail: Top and skirt travel flat without collar and headgear taking revenge, and chiffon shakes its creases out in a steamy bathroom - the sailor look at its most portable.
19382.short_add: The sailor format that survives a suitcase.

19461.tail: Red against white apron is the contrast that makes the set read instantly, and a cold gentle wash keeps the red out of the apron - polyester dries overnight on a hanger for December calendars.

21198.tail: Black or white to match whichever headband half the costume already has - the bow-and-bell neck ring is the finishing piece most cat and maid sets arrive without.
21198.short_add: The finishing piece most sets ship without.

19878.tail: Blue reads the classic reference and red the departure, and the top-and-panties format packs flat for weekends where a theme is on the itinerary but luggage space is not.
19878.short_add: Classic or departure, packed to pocket size.

20337.tail: The chest patch is selective coverage - a decision the fully open alternatives never make - and stockings arriving in the set close the one open question the genre usually leaves.
20337.short_add: Selective coverage plus the stockings question closed.

19295.tail: The silhouette works any month the occasion demands, with the Christmas red as seasonal dressing rather than structural identity - M and L by weight band, cheongsam collar doing the identifying.
19295.short_add: Seasonal color on a year-round silhouette.
